Mission.headline: Umyalezo awutshintshi. Indlela abantu ababukela ngayo iyatshintsha.
Mission.intro: Siphinda sakha ithala lethu leevidiyo nezixhobo ukusuka ekuqaleni, sizisa umsebenzi weminyaka emininzi wenguqulelo kumaqonga apho abantu sele behlanganisana khona, bebukela kwaye besabelana.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Elona thala leefilimu eliguqulelwe kakhulu emhlabeni
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Iminyaka emininzi yomsebenzi wenguqulelo, iqhutywa ngamaqabane enkonzo athembekileyo, yakhe ithala elinamawaka eetraki zeelwimi, ukuze abantu badibane nebali likaYesu ngolwimi olubachukumisa nzulu.
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Siphinda sakha indlela amabali eendaba ezilungileyo abaliswa ngayo ngokubonakalayo, sidibanisa iinguqulelo ezithembekileyo neefomathi zale mihla, ukuze umyalezo uhambe ngokukhululekileyo kumaqonga, kwiinkcubeko nakwizikrini.
Mission.teamPointDescription: IJesus Film Project liqela lehlabathi labaguquleli, iingcali zemidiya, abahleli nabadali, eliguqula amava eminyaka emininzi enkonzo abe zizixhobo zabo benza abafundi kuyo yonke indawo.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Nxulumanisa ababukeli namathuba abonakalayo kuhambo lwabo lokomoya, ubancede bathathe inyathelo elilandelayo besiya kuluntu, eZibhalweni okanye kwimishini.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Ithala elibanzi lemidiya yobuKristu elinamawaka eevidiyo, iifilimu nezixhobo ezifumaneka ngeelwimi ezininzi, ukwenzela inkonzo nokushumayela ivangeli kwihlabathi liphela.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ulawulo lwevidiyo, ukusasazwa komxholo, ukubandakanywa kwababukeli nohlalutyo, kuyilelwe ukunceda iinkonzo zifikelele kubantu abaninzi ngempumelelo.
Mission.inviteBody: Simema iingcali, abadali namaqabane ukuba bangene kwangethuba. Vavanya izixhobo ezitsha kuqala, unike izimvo zakho, uze uncede ukubumba iimveliso ezenzelwe umsebenzi wokwenene wemishini.
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Ivula iphepha lemishini yeJesus Film kwicandelo lesicwangciso
